# eventb-skill

> Agent skills for developing Event-B formal models as .eventb text and checking them with the rossi toolchain and eventb-animate.

## Install

```sh
npx skills add eventb-rossi/eventb-skill
```

## Prerequisites

The skill drives two command-line tools and checks for them before modelling:

- [rossi](https://github.com/eventb-rossi/rossi) 0.2.0+ — parser, static checker,
  formatter and Rodin round-tripping for `.eventb` text.
- [eventb-animate](https://github.com/eventb-rossi/eventb-animate) 6.4+ — ProB-backed
  model checking, well-definedness gates and trace replay. Needs Java 21+.

## On-demand fetch

Read a file directly instead of installing the skill:

### eventb

Write and check Event-B formal models as `.eventb` text: contexts, machines, invariants, events, and justified refinement chains.

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eventb-rossi/eventb-skill/main/skills/eventb/SKILL.md) — the entry point.
